svg.title: GigPies — Audio and light. Two consoles. One system.
svg.desc: Intended GigPies operator setup: audio console SHR Desk and lighting console SHR Lightdesk, each with a 1920 by 1080 screen and a separate MIDI keyboard controller, on one Brain. Stagebox owns local audio and recording; SHR Lux owns the lighting engine. Manual, Assist and Auto are modes. Surface integration is planned.

g.text: Mix and play it your way.
SHR Desk → audio control • SHR Lightdesk → SHR Lux engine
